## Feature Implementation Details

### 1. URL Query Parameter Sync
- Filter state initializes from URL params on page load
- URL updates when filters are applied
- Enables shareable/bookmarkable filtered views
- Example: `/episodes?status=scored&sortBy=title&page=2`

### 2. Apply/Reset Buttons
- Apply button: Primary styling, triggers filter application
- Reset button: Secondary styling, clears all filters to defaults
- Both buttons positioned in filter grid (2-column span)

### 3. Active Filter Chips
- Appear below filter controls when non-default filters are active
- Color-coded: Search (primary-100), Status (green-100), Sort/Dir (gray-100)
- Each chip has an X button to remove that specific filter
- Removing a filter immediately applies the change

### 4. Pagination URL Sync
- Previous/Next buttons update URL with page number
- Direct URL access to specific page works correctly
- Page resets to 0 when filters change
